text: The system monitors battery voltage, battery temperature and state of charge. The BatteryMonitor software component publishes battery status information. The ThermalController consumes battery temperature and generates a cooling request. The Dashboard consumes battery status for driver display.

The application layer contains BatteryMonitor, ThermalController and Dashboard. Communication between application components is performed through defined ports and interfaces. The Runtime Environment (RTE) provides the communication mechanism between application software components. Synthetic AUTOSAR HLD — Training/Demonstration Document Page 2

3.1 BatteryMonitor BatteryMonitor acquires battery measurements and calculates BatteryStatus. It provides BatteryVoltage, BatteryTemperature and BatteryStatus information to other components. 3.2 ThermalController ThermalController receives BatteryTemperature from BatteryMonitor and determines whether cooling is required. It publishes CoolingRequest to the cooling subsystem. 3.3 Dashboard Dashboard receives BatteryStatus and presents battery information to the vehicle user.

5.1 BatteryMonitor Ports P_BatteryVoltage provides battery voltage information. P_BatteryTemperature provides battery temperature information. P_BatteryStatus provides calculated battery status. 5.2 ThermalController Ports R_BatteryTemperature receives battery temperature. P_CoolingRequest provides the requested cooling state. 5.3 Dashboard Ports R_BatteryStatus receives BatteryStatus. P_DisplayUpdate provides the updated display information.

BatteryVoltage and BatteryTemperature are measurement data produced by BatteryMonitor. BatteryStatus is derived from battery measurements and is consumed by Dashboard. BatteryTemperature is consumed by ThermalController. CoolingRequest is generated by ThermalController.

text: BatteryMonitor provides BatteryTemperature to ThermalController. 4. ThermalController evaluates the temperature and generates CoolingRequest. 5. BatteryMonitor provides BatteryStatus to Dashboard. 6. Dashboard updates the driver display.

ThermalController depends on BatteryMonitor for BatteryTemperature. Dashboard depends on BatteryMonitor for BatteryStatus. CoolingSystem depends on ThermalController for CoolingRequest. Synthetic AUTOSAR HLD — Training/Demonstration Document Page 5

The primary application relationships are: • BatteryMonitor → ThermalController through BatteryMeasurementInterface • BatteryMonitor → Dashboard through BatteryStatusInterface • ThermalController → CoolingSystem through CoolingRequestInterface

Every consumed data element should have a defined provider. Every interface should identify its provider and consumer. Component names, port names and interface names should remain consistent across architecture sections.

Version 1.0 is the baseline demonstration revision. Future revisions may add new components, signals, interfaces or dependencies. The HLD analysis assistant should compare revisions and report potential additions, removals and inconsistencies for engineer review.
